ShowAmount.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchantCardType.maps_to: VigorousEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:448-452) -- `card_type == CardType.ATTACK`, matching Vigorous.cs:13-16. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

EnchantDamageAdditive.maps_to: VigorousEnchantment.modify_damage_additive (enchantments.py:454-458) -- returns `amount` for its own card while not disabled, matching Vigorous.cs:18-29's two guards (`Status != Normal -> 0m`, `!props.IsPoweredAttack() -> 0m`, else `base.Amount`); the powered gate is hoisted into the caller (cmds.py:56). The grant sets amount 8 (events/stone_of_all_time.py:_VIGOROUS_AMOUNT). Additive-only, so BR-1's phase difference cannot bite. Pinned: test/test_shared_enchantments.py::test_vigorous_bonus_applies_once_then_spends.

AfterCardPlayed.maps_to: VigorousEnchantment.on_card_played (enchantments.py:460-462) -- sets `disabled` for its own card, matching Vigorous.cs:31-38
AfterCardPlayed.issue: Per-replay firing. See guard EG1: C# fires AfterCardPlayed once per Replay iteration (CardModel.cs:1959), so the FIRST play gets the bonus and the second does not; the sim's on_card_played runs once, after the whole loop, so every replay of the same play gets it. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py replay`): Vigorous(8) on a base-6 Strike played twice by the ported Throwing Axe relic deals 28 in the sim and 20 in the game (6+8 then 6). LIVE: Vigorous comes from the ported Stone of All Time event (events/stone_of_all_time.py:69-71) and Throwing Axe is a ported Ancient relic; an 8-damage error is the largest single-play divergence in this kind.

guards.what: EG1: EnchantmentModel.OnPlay is a DIRECT call inside the per-Replay loop, placed after the card's own OnPlay and before Hook.AfterCardPlayed (CardModel.cs:1904 `for (i < playCount)`, 1931 `await OnPlay(...)`, 1937-1945 `await Enchantment.OnPlay(...)`, 1959 `Hook.AfterCardPlayed`). The sim has no such slot: the three OnPlay ports hang off before_card_played / on_card_played, both of which fire ONCE per card play, outside the replay loop (combat.py:466 and combat.py:514)
guards.issue: Vigorous's AfterCardPlayed leg, executed above (28 vs 20). Same mechanism as Goopy's Amount++ and Corrupted's OnPlay: the sim has no per-replay slot, so every enchantment hook that C# fires inside the loop is collapsed to one firing outside it. LIVE.

guards.what: BR-2 (blast radius): audits/seam/hook_dispatch.json gap G4 -- the game builds a fresh CardPlay and fires Hook.BeforeCardPlayed / Hook.AfterCardPlayed once per Replay iteration (CardModel.cs:1919-1964), the sim fires before_card_played / on_card_played once per card play (combat.py:466, 514)
guards.issue: ALREADY RECORDED as hook_dispatch G4 (rule 3, same verdict, not re-verdicted). Recorded here because this unit's port rides on one of those two hooks, so G4's once-per-play shape is what makes EG1's replay leg observable. {extra}
guards.extra: Vigorous is the highest-magnitude witness of the replay leg: 8 damage.
